description:
Order a title search report for a property. `address` is the street address (house number, street,
    city, ZIP), `state` the two-letter code, `county` the county (or borough/city alias). Returns an order_id;
    then poll get_order_status every ~20 seconds until status is 'complete' (usually 1 to 3 minutes), and call
    get_report. Free during the launch period. `email` is optional (used only for the report link; nothing is
    sent while email delivery is off).
name: order_title_search
